keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Joel Waterman (Portland Timbers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Ibrahim Aliyu (Houston Dynamo FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ian Smith (Portland Timbers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Portland Timbers 1, Houston Dynamo FC 0. David da Costa (Portland Timbers) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Vincent Janssen.
Delay in match because of an injury Franco Negri (Houston Dynamo FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Duane Holmes replaces Franco Negri because of an injury.
Diadié Samassékou (Houston Dynamo FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Portland Timbers 1, Houston Dynamo FC 0.
Second Half begins Portland Timbers 1, Houston Dynamo FC 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Diadié Samassékou (Houston Dynamo FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Agustin Resch (Houston Dynamo FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Cole Bassett replaces Eric Izoita.

Goal! Portland Timbers 2, Houston Dynamo FC 0. Kristoffer Velde (Portland Timbers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Vincent Janssen following a fast break.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Duncan McGuire replaces Lyle Foster.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Felipe Andrade replaces Ibrahim Aliyu.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Matthew Arana replaces Artur.
Goal! Portland Timbers 2, Houston Dynamo FC 1. Agustín Bouzat (Houston Dynamo FC) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Duncan McGuire.
Delay in match because of an injury José Caicedo (Portland Timbers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Portland Timbers 3, Houston Dynamo FC 1. Vincent Janssen (Portland Timbers) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by David da Costa with a cross following a corner.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Alexander Aravena replaces Vincent Janssen.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Omir Fernandez replaces Ariel Lassiter.
Substitution, Houston Dynamo FC. Nick Markanich replaces Duane Holmes.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Joao Ortiz replaces José Caicedo.
Substitution, Portland Timbers. Diego Chará replaces David da Costa.
Diego Chará (Portland Timbers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Portland Timbers 3, Houston Dynamo FC 1.
